#include <iostream>
#include <string>
#include <chrono>
using namespace std;

int main() {
    auto start = chrono::steady_clock::now();
    int n;
    string s;
    cin >> n >> s;
    
    bool inner = false;
    int len = 0;
    int maxOutside = 0;
    int insideWords = 0;
    
    for (char c : s) {
        if (c == '_' || c == '(' || c == ')') {
            if (inner) {
                if (len > 0) insideWords++;
            } else {
                if (len > maxOutside) maxOutside = len;
            }
            if (c == '(') inner = true;
            else if (c == ')') inner = false;
            len = 0;
        } else {
            len++;
        }
    }
    
    if (inner) {
        if (len > 0) insideWords++;
    } else {
        if (len > maxOutside) maxOutside = len;
    }
    
    cout << maxOutside << " " << insideWords << endl;
    
    #ifdef ONLINE_JUDGE
    // suppress debug output
    #else
    auto end = chrono::steady_clock::now();
    auto elapsed = chrono::duration_cast<chrono::milliseconds>(end - start);
    cout << "[" << elapsed.count() << "ms]" << endl;
    #endif
    
    return 0;
}
